target.title: Redesign web viewer as WhatsApp-style archive reader
target.body: Complete redesign of the `wacrawl web` viewer as a WhatsApp-style archive reader. The previous "field notes" layout is replaced by a familiar two-pane chat UI, built with the same constraints as before: vanilla HTML/CSS/JS embedded via `go:embed`, zero external assets, and the strict CSP (`default-src 'none'`) untouched. ## What's new **Layout & look** - Two-pane WhatsApp-style layout: chat list sidebar + conversation pane with the classic doodle wallpaper (inline SVG data URI, no network). - Dark, light, and auto themes (cycle button, persisted in `localStorage`, follows `prefers-color-scheme` in auto). - Message bubbles with tails, per-day sticky date chips, sent-message double ticks, starred markers, and jumbo rendering for emoji-only messages. - Deterministic avatars everywhere (chat list, chat header, group senders, search results): initials on a gradient derived from the JID hash, with glyphs for groups/newsletters/unnamed contacts. Group sender names get stable per-sender colors, WhatsApp-style. - Archive stats panel, chat filters (All / Unread / Groups), unread pills, kind/archived tags, and a responsive mobile layout with back navigation. **Markdown / WhatsApp formatting** - Messages render `*bold*`/`**bold**`, `_italic_`, `~strike~`/`~~strike~~`, `` `inline code` ``, ```` ``` ````fenced blocks, `> quotes`, bullet and numbered lists, and auto-linked http(s) URLs. - The renderer is a hand-rolled tokenizer that only ever builds DOM nodes (`createElement`/`textContent`) — message content is never parsed as HTML, so the CSP posture is unchanged. **Server (small, focused changes)** - `/api/messages` gains optional `before` + `before_pk` params — a composite pagination cursor powering the "Load older messages" button; the tie-breaker keeps paging correct even when many messages share one second. - Message responses include `source_pk` (already public in CLI JSON) as the stable row key. - Search snippets wrap matches in Unicode private-use markers (configurable via `store.MessageFilter`; CLI keeps `[`/`]`), so the client can highlight matches without colliding with real message text. ## Screenshots All data below is a fictional demo archive seeded for screenshots. **Dark — group chat with markdown, media cards, avatars** ![chat dark](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openclaw/wacrawl/web-ui-redesign/docs/assets/webui-chat-dark.png) **Light theme** ![chat light](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openclaw/wacrawl/web-ui-redesign/docs/assets/webui-chat-light.png) **Full-text search with highlighted matches** ![search dark](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openclaw/wacrawl/web-ui-redesign/docs/assets/webui-search-dark.png) **Mobile layout** ## Security posture (unchanged) - Loopback-only listener, per-run bearer key in the URL fragment, key consumed into memory and stripped from the address bar. - CSP still `default-src 'none'` with no inline script/style; all icons are runtime-built inline SVG, wallpaper is a data URI (`img-src data:` was already allowed). - No media bytes/paths served, GET-only, no write surface. ## Testing - `go test ./...` green; `golangci-lint run` clean. - New server tests: `before`/`before_pk` pagination (including same-second tie-break), snippet marker output, invalid-param rejections. - Verified in headless Chromium (Playwright) across dark/light/mobile: chat rendering, markdown, search, stats panel, pagination; no console errors.
